name: Dhamma Makaranda

location.city: San Bartolo Amanalco, Municipio de Amanalco
location.region: State of Mexico (near Valle de Bravo)

tradition: Vipassana as taught by S.N. Goenka (U Ba Khin lineage)
technique: Anapana/Vipassana body-scan technique, Noble Silence throughout
teacherAccess: Recorded discourse; resident/assistant teachers give personal interviews
retreatOptions: 10-day standard new-student courses; occasional 3-day/Satipatthana/longer courses for old students; children's/teen courses
about: The first dedicated Vipassana center built in Latin America, opened on donated forested land in the early 2000s near Valle de Bravo. Runs the standard worldwide Goenka course structure -- old and new students alike sit fixed 10-day courses on identical timetables, with separate men's/women's dorms, a dining hall, and a pagoda-style meditation hall. Spanish- and English-language courses alternate through the year.
schedule: Regular, monthly-ish cadence per online calendar
cost: Dana/donation-only; no fee charged or requested at registration
workNotes: Optional/light Dhamma-service chores for course logistics; not mandatory for participants.
